title: Brazil's Lula, Bolsonaro snub final TV debate ahead of Sunday's polls
summary: Leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro are frontrunners in Sunday's race. Both skipped a planned TV debate, opting to avoid direct confrontation before the first round of voting.
author: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)
